body: A source comment referencing this project's own review process (a round number, a finding id, "codex flagged") alongside a classification/dismissal word ("not a defect", "not independently closable") is authority-smuggling: repository content instructing a future reviewer, human or model, how to weigh a finding. This pattern recurred three times in this session's work (a spec doc's "review status: closed" headers, a test-file "not a defect ... deferred" comment, and a code comment calling an open limitation "not a new independently-closable bug"), each time caught only by a live adversarial-review pass. Mined via lesson-foundry from the repeated-finding cluster in .adlc/findings.jsonl and proposed as a P7 defense. Adds scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs (a diff-scoped lint gate reconstructing full comment spans around every added line) wired into preflight and CI, protects the gate's own source/test as a trust root (REPO_TRUST_ROOTS + CODEOWNERS), and fixes an independently-verified bug this work surfaced in the shared parseAddedLines diff parser (an added `++ ` line collides with the `+++ b/path` new-file header). Verification: node --test scripts/test/check-reviewer-directed-comments.test.mjs, node --test packages/rails-guard/test/suppressions.test.mjs, node --test scripts/test/rails-guard-ci.test.mjs, node --test scripts/test/preflight.test.mjs all green; node scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs <base> exits 0 on this repo's own history.
title: distill: deterministic gate for authority-smuggling reviewer-directed comments (P7)
